ai_summary: DEE Development Engineers Limited has approved its Q1 FY2026-27 unaudited financial results, reporting substantial year-over-year growth in revenue and net profit, despite a sequential decline from the previous quarter. A key takeaway is the continued loss in the power division, further complicated by an unadjusted, sub-judice dispute with PSPCL over a retrospective tariff reduction that represents a material financial risk, as highlighted by the auditor's "Emphasis of Matter."
